clips.title: The story
paras: In Thelsamar, Magistrate Bluntnose hires passing fighters as Mo'grosh ogres press into northeastern Loch Modan. Ironforge's promised soldiers are months away, leaving the valley's settlements, excavations, and Stonewrought Dam exposed.

Ironforge has taken months to send help to Loch Modan. Two months passed before it promised a handful of soldiers for the valley's defense, and another two months will pass before they arrive. With Thelsamar's guards stretched thin and hostile forces gathering beyond the valley, Magistrate Bluntnose cannot wait.

Mo'grosh ogres have fortified a camp in the hills northeast of the loch. Their growing presence threatens Thelsamar, the Ironband Excavation Site, and the Stonewrought Dam. If the dam is attacked or damaged, the destruction downstream would be catastrophic. Without official mountaineer detachments, Bluntnose hires independent fighters to thin the ogre ranks and buy the valley time against ogres and troggs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Two months just to hear from Ironforge that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.
I've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.
How about you? You seem a likely sort, adventurer. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you could recruit some others and help remove the threat to our town?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.
